findings.title: Requests will honor environment proxies, allowing outbound fetches to be redirected off-allowlist
findings.evidence: The call to requests.get does not disable trust in environment proxy settings, so in supported deployments with HTTP(S)_PROXY configured the request can be sent to an arbitrary proxy even after URL validation.
findings.recommendation: Use a Session with trust_env set to False, or pass proxies={} in a way that reliably disables environment proxy use for this code path, so validated URLs are fetched directly.

findings.title: Allowlist check can be bypassed with a trailing-dot hostname form
findings.evidence: The hostname is compared directly against the allowlist after lowercasing, but DNS treats a trailing dot as equivalent, so an input like https://api.example.com./ will not match the allowlist while still resolving to the same host form if later code or callers normalize differently.
findings.evidence_quote: if host is None or host.lower() not in ALLOWED_HOSTS:
findings.recommendation: Canonicalize hostnames before comparison, for example by lowercasing and stripping a single trailing dot, and use the same canonical form for DNS resolution and request dispatch.
